name: Telegram Finance Tracker (Indonesian amounts, budgets, CSV import, recurring payments)

parameters.content:
## Telegram Finance Tracker
Track spending by chatting. Send `25rb makan siang`, `grab 38.000 #transport` or `+5jt gaji`; the bot understands Indonesian amounts (25rb, 1,5jt, Rp25.000), picks a category from your keyword rules, and warns you once at 80 % and once at 100 % of a monthly budget.

**Also:** `/month`, `/today`, `/undo`, `/budget food 2jt`, `/rule grab transport`. `POST /webhook/finance-import` imports a bank CSV (idempotent). A weekly report shows spending, budgets, pace and **detected recurring payments** (subscriptions, rent).

**Before running:** run `sql/schema.sql`; create credentials (Postgres, Telegram, Header Auth 'Finance import key'); in *Parse Message* put your chat id(s) into `ALLOWED_CHAT_IDS`; replace `REPLACE_WITH_REPORT_CHAT_ID` (2 nodes) and `REPLACE_ID`; set the Error Workflow to this workflow. Amounts are whole rupiah.

### Privacy
The bot answers only chat ids listed in `ALLOWED_CHAT_IDS` (empty or placeholder = nobody). CSV imports store date, amount and description only. Remove card and account numbers from descriptions before importing if your bank includes them.

parameters.query:
WITH cfg AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date AS today FROM settings),
cat AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN $2::text = 'income' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF($4::text, ''), 'income')
              ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF($4::text, ''),
                   (SELECT r.category FROM category_rules r WHERE lower($3::text) LIKE '%' || r.keyword || '%'
                    ORDER BY length(r.keyword) DESC, r.keyword LIMIT 1), 'other') END AS name
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO transactions (chat_id, kind, amount, note, category, source, tx_date)
  SELECT $1::bigint, $2::text, $5::bigint, $3::text, cat.name, 'telegram', cfg.today FROM cat, cfg
  RETURNING id, kind, amount, category, tx_date
),
bud AS (SELECT b.monthly_amount FROM budgets b JOIN ins ON ins.category = b.category WHERE ins.kind = 'expense'),
prior AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS s FROM transactions t, ins
  WHERE t.kind = 'expense' AND NOT t.deleted AND t.category = ins.category
    AND t.tx_date >= date_trunc('month', ins.tx_date::timestamp)::date
    AND t.tx_date < (date_trunc('month', ins.tx_date::timestamp) + interval '1 month')::date
),
levels AS (
  SELECT l AS level FROM unnest(ARRAY[80, 100]) AS l, bud, prior, ins
  WHERE prior.s * 100 < l * bud.monthly_amount AND (prior.s + ins.amount) * 100 >= l * bud.monthly_amount
),
al AS (
  INSERT INTO budget_alerts (month, category, level)
  SELECT date_trunc('month', ins.tx_date::timestamp)::date, ins.category, levels.level FROM ins, levels
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING level
)
SELECT ins.id, ins.kind, ins.amount::bigint AS amount, ins.category, to_char(ins.tx_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tx_date,
       (SELECT monthly_amount FROM bud)::bigint AS budget,
       ((SELECT s FROM prior) + CASE WHEN ins.kind = 'expense' THEN ins.amount ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS month_spent,
       COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(level ORDER BY level) FROM al), ARRAY[]::int[]) AS alerts
FROM ins;

WITH cfg AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date AS today FROM settings),
m AS (
  SELECT t.category,
         SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.kind = 'expense') AS spent,
         SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.kind = 'income') AS income
  FROM transactions t, cfg
  WHERE NOT t.deleted
    AND t.tx_date >= date_trunc('month', cfg.today::timestamp)::date
    AND t.tx_date < (date_trunc('month', cfg.today::timestamp) + interval '1 month')::date
  GROUP BY t.category
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.category, b.category) AS category,
       COALESCE(m.spent, 0)::bigint AS spent, COALESCE(m.income, 0)::bigint AS income, b.monthly_amount::bigint AS budget,
       to_char(cfg.today, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS today,
       EXTRACT(day FROM cfg.today)::int AS dom,
       EXTRACT(day FROM (date_trunc('month', cfg.today::timestamp) + interval '1 month - 1 day'))::int AS dim
FROM m FULL JOIN budgets b ON b.category = m.category CROSS JOIN cfg
ORDER BY COALESCE(m.spent, 0) DESC, 1;

UPDATE transactions SET deleted = TRUE
WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM transactions WHERE chat_id = $1::bigint AND NOT deleted AND created_at > now() - interval '30 minutes'
            ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1)
RETURNING id, kind, amount::bigint AS amount, note, category;

WITH rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r(tx_date date, kind text, amount bigint, note text, occ int)
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO transactions (chat_id, kind, amount, note, category, source, tx_date, dedupe_key)
  SELECT NULL::bigint, r.kind, r.amount, r.note,
         CASE WHEN r.kind = 'income' THEN 'income'
              ELSE COALESCE((SELECT ru.category FROM category_rules ru WHERE lower(r.note) LIKE '%' || ru.keyword || '%'
                             ORDER BY length(ru.keyword) DESC, ru.keyword LIMIT 1), 'other') END,
         'csv', r.tx_date,
         md5(r.tx_date::text || '|' || r.kind || '|' || r.amount::text || '|' || lower(r.note)) || '#' || r.occ::text
  FROM rows r
  ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING kind, amount
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rows)::int AS parsed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins)::int AS inserted,
       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM ins WHERE kind = 'expense'), 0)::bigint AS expense_total,
       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM ins WHERE kind = 'income'), 0)::bigint AS income_total;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'imported', rows_in_file: $('Parse CSV').first().json.rows_in_file, parsed: $json.parsed, skipped: $('Parse CSV').first().json.skipped, inserted: $json.inserted, duplicates: $json.parsed - $json.inserted, expense_total: $json.expense_total, income_total: $json.income_total, errors: $('Parse CSV').first().json.errors } }}

WITH cfg AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date AS today FROM settings),
m AS (
  SELECT t.category,
         SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.kind = 'expense') AS spent,
         SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.kind = 'income') AS income
  FROM transactions t, cfg
  WHERE NOT t.deleted
    AND t.tx_date >= date_trunc('month', cfg.today::timestamp)::date
    AND t.tx_date < (date_trunc('month', cfg.today::timestamp) + interval '1 month')::date
  GROUP BY t.category
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.category, b.category) AS category,
       COALESCE(m.spent, 0)::bigint AS spent, COALESCE(m.income, 0)::bigint AS income, b.monthly_amount::bigint AS budget,
       to_char(cfg.today, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS today,
       EXTRACT(day FROM cfg.today)::int AS dom,
       EXTRACT(day FROM (date_trunc('month', cfg.today::timestamp) + interval '1 month - 1 day'))::int AS dim
FROM m FULL JOIN budgets b ON b.category = m.category CROSS JOIN cfg
ORDER BY COALESCE(m.spent, 0) DESC, 1;

WITH cfg AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date AS today FROM settings),
w AS (SELECT t.* FROM transactions t, cfg WHERE NOT t.deleted AND t.tx_date > cfg.today - 7 AND t.tx_date <= cfg.today)
(SELECT 'cat' AS section, category, SUM(amount)::bigint AS amount, NULL::text AS note, NULL::text AS tx_date FROM w WHERE kind = 'expense' GROUP BY category)
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'income', 'income', COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)::bigint, NULL::text, NULL::text FROM w WHERE kind = 'income')
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'top', category, amount::bigint, note, to_char(tx_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM w WHERE kind = 'expense' ORDER BY amount DESC, id LIMIT 5);

SELECT note, amount::bigint AS amount, to_char(tx_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tx_date
FROM transactions
WHERE NOT deleted AND kind = 'expense' AND tx_date > (now() AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM settings))::date - 200
ORDER BY tx_date LIMIT 5000;
